title: Healthcheck Configuration
description: Runtime-aware health semantics for a Nosana deployment. Accounts for model loading time, retry behavior, and degradation thresholds.

enabled.description: Whether health checks should be configured for this deployment

body.description: Request body for POST probes (JSON string)

headers.description: HTTP headers for the probe request

startup_grace_period_seconds.description: How long to wait before the first health check (accounts for model loading time)

max_startup_wait_seconds.description: Maximum time to wait for the service to become healthy before marking as failed

continuous.description: Whether to keep checking after initial success (true for production load balancing)

max_consecutive_failures.description: Number of consecutive failures before marking service as degraded

recovery_action.description: What to do when degradation threshold is breached

grace_period_reasoning.description: Why this grace period was chosen (e.g., '7B FP16 model typically loads in 60-120s on RTX 4090')
